## Munge

### Endophenotypes

```{r}
merge.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADNIMERGE_25Sep2023.csv")
cog.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Assessment_Analyses/ADSP_ADNI_Cognition_Dec2023/ADSP_PHC_COGN_Dec2023.csv")
names(merge.raw)

dx_bl <- filter(cog.raw, PHC_Visit == 1) %>% 
    mutate(
    dx_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Diagnosis == "1" ~ "CN", 
      PHC_Diagnosis == "2" ~ "MCI", 
      PHC_Diagnosis == "3" ~ "AD", 
     ), 
    dx_bl = fct_relevel(dx_bl, "CN", "MCI", "AD"), 
  ) %>%
    select(RID, dx_bl)


```

```{r}
# Fluid Biomarkers
## ~100 are missing fluid bm; ~200 fluid bm collected after genetics; ~200 collected at baseline, 66 collected before genetics
fluid_bm.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Biospecimen_Analyses/ADSP_PHC_CSF_Dec2023.csv")

flbm <- fluid_bm.raw %>%
  select(RID, VISCODE, DRAWDATE, PHC_Visit, Platform, PHC_AB42, PHC_Tau, PHC_pTau, AT_class)


```

```{r}
mri.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Image_Analyses/ADSP_ADNI_T1-Scalar_Dec2023v2/ADSP_PHC_T1-FS_Dec2023.csv")

mri <- mri.raw %>%
  select(RID, SUBJID, PHASE, VISCODE, VISCODE2, SCANDATE, PHC_Visit, PHC_Age_T1,PHC_ScannerBatchName, PHC_LONIUID, PHC_ScanID,
    PHC_ScannerBatchName.1, PHC_ScannerManufacturer, PHC_FieldSgth, EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol_combat, 
    rh_entorhinal_thickness_combat, lh_entorhinal_thickness_combat,
    rh_entorhinal_volume_combat, lh_entorhinal_volume_combat,
    rh_inferiortemporal_thickness_combat, lh_inferiortemporal_thickness_combat,
    rh_inferiortemporal_volume_combat, lh_inferiortemporal_volume_combat,
    rh_middletemporal_thickness_combat, lh_middletemporal_thickness_combat,
    rh_middletemporal_volume_combat, lh_middletemporal_volume_combat,
    rh_fusiform_thickness_combat, lh_fusiform_thickness_combat,
    lh_fusiform_volume_combat, rh_fusiform_volume_combat, 
    rh_inferiorparietal_thickness_combat, lh_inferiorparietal_thickness_combat,
    lh_inferiorparietal_volume_combat, rh_inferiorparietal_volume_combat,
    rh_precuneus_thickness_combat, lh_precuneus_thickness_combat, 
    lh_precuneus_volume_combat, rh_precuneus_volume_combat,
    Right.Hippocampus_combat, Left.Hippocampus_combat,
    Right.Amygdala_combat, Left.Amygdala_combat,
    rh_temporalpole_volume_combat, lh_temporalpole_volume_combat,
 ) %>%
  mutate(
    icv = EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol_combat,
    ## Cortical Thickness
    ent_thk = rowMeans(across(c(rh_entorhinal_thickness_combat, lh_entorhinal_thickness_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    fus_thk = rowMeans(across(c(rh_fusiform_thickness_combat, lh_fusiform_thickness_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    ift_thk = rowMeans(across(c(rh_inferiortemporal_thickness_combat, lh_inferiortemporal_thickness_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    mt_thk = rowMeans(across(c(rh_middletemporal_thickness_combat, lh_middletemporal_thickness_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    ifp_thk = rowMeans(across(c(rh_inferiorparietal_thickness_combat, lh_inferiorparietal_thickness_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    pcun_thk = rowMeans(across(c(rh_precuneus_thickness_combat, lh_precuneus_thickness_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    cort_thk = rowMeans(across(c(ent_thk, fus_thk, ift_thk, mt_thk, ifp_thk, pcun_thk)), na.rm = FALSE),
    ## GM Volume
    ent_vol = rowMeans(across(c(rh_entorhinal_volume_combat, lh_entorhinal_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    ift_vol = rowMeans(across(c(rh_inferiortemporal_volume_combat, lh_inferiortemporal_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    mt_vol = rowMeans(across(c(rh_middletemporal_volume_combat, lh_middletemporal_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    hipp_vol = rowMeans(across(c(Right.Hippocampus_combat, Left.Hippocampus_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    amyg_vol = rowMeans(across(c(Right.Amygdala_combat, Left.Amygdala_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    tpol_vol = rowMeans(across(c(rh_temporalpole_volume_combat, lh_temporalpole_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    gm_vol = rowSums(across(c(hipp_vol, amyg_vol, ent_vol, mt_vol, ift_vol, tpol_vol)), na.rm = FALSE),
    ## Weighted average of cortical thickness 
    fus_vol = rowMeans(across(c(lh_fusiform_volume_combat, rh_fusiform_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    ifp_vol = rowMeans(across(c(lh_inferiorparietal_volume_combat, rh_inferiorparietal_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),
    pcun_vol = rowMeans(across(c(lh_precuneus_volume_combat, rh_precuneus_volume_combat)), na.rm = FALSE),

    cort_thk_volwt =
      (ent_vol  * ent_thk  +
       fus_vol  * fus_thk  +
       ift_vol  * ift_thk  +
       mt_vol   * mt_thk   +
       ifp_vol  * ifp_thk  +
       pcun_vol * pcun_thk) /
      (ent_vol + fus_vol + ift_vol + mt_vol + ifp_vol + pcun_vol),
  )
 
mri %>%
  select(RID, cort_thk, cort_thk_volwt, gm_vol)
 
```

### Methylation

```{r}
## Mythylation
map.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("resources/ADNI/ADNI_DNA_Methylation_SampleAnnotation_20170530.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(Edate = as.Date(Edate))
clocks.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/adni_epiclocks_240826.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) 
deconv6.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/DeconvoluteBloodEPIC_results.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -barcodes, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = barcodes, values_from = Value)
deconv12.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/TwelveCellDeconvoluteBloodEPIC_results.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -barcodes, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = barcodes, values_from = Value)

dnam.raw <- map.raw %>%
  dplyr::select(barcodes, RID, Phase,  Edate, DateDrawn, PlateNumber, Array) %>%
  rename(Phase_methy = Phase,  Edate_methy = Edate, DateDrawn_methy = DateDrawn) %>%
  arrange(RID, Edate_methy, PlateNumber) %>%
  left_join(clocks.raw, by = 'barcodes') %>%
  left_join(deconv6.raw, by = c('barcodes' = 'Sample')) %>%
  # left_join(deconv12.raw, by = c('barcodes' = 'Sample')) %>%
  left_join(select(cog.raw, RID, EXAMDATE, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Sex, PHC_Diagnosis), by = c("RID", 'Edate_methy' = "EXAMDATE")) %>%
  relocate(RID, Edate_methy, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Sex, PHC_Diagnosis) %>%
  select(-Age) %>%
  rename(Age = PHC_Age_Cognition, dx = PHC_Diagnosis, sex = PHC_Sex) %>%
  mutate(
      dx = case_when(
        dx == 1 ~ "CN",
        dx == 2 ~ "MCI",
        dx == 3 ~ "AD",
   ),
  )

dnam <- dnam.raw %>% 
  group_by(RID, Edate_methy) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3)%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Age)

```

### Telomeres
- TL_BP_ADJ: Telomere length / Single copy gene (T/S) ratio of DNA from blood, adjusted for logistical confounders

```{r}
## Telomere Ration
ts.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/TS_RATIO_ADJ_23Aug2024.csv")

ts <- ts.raw %>% 
  arrange(RID, EXAM_DATE) %>%
  group_by(RID, EXAM_DATE) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  ungroup() 
  
```

### mtDNAcn 
```{r}
load('resources/ADNI/BioAge/adni_mtcn.RData')
mtDNAcn.raw <- dat_adni
mtdnacn <- mtDNAcn.raw %>% 
  dplyr::select(RID, mtcn) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%

  )

```

### APOE

```{r}
## APOE 
apoe.raw <- read_csv('resources/ADNI/APOERES_15Nov2023.csv')
apoe <- apoe.raw %>%
  unite(apoe_geno, c(APGEN1, APGEN2), sep = "") %>%
  mutate(
    apoe = case_when(
      apoe_geno == "22" ~ "e2+", 
      apoe_geno == "23" ~ "e2+", 
      apoe_geno == "24" ~ "e4+", 
      apoe_geno == "33" ~ "e3/e3", 
      apoe_geno == "34" ~ "e4+", 
      apoe_geno == "44" ~ "e4+", 
    ), 
    apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
  ) %>%
   fastDummies::dummy_cols(select_columns = "apoe", remove_most_frequent_dummy = T) %>%
  rename(apoe_e2 = `apoe_e2+`, apoe_e4 = `apoe_e4+`)
  
 
```

### Smoking 
```{r}
### Medical history 
med_hist.raw <- read_csv('resources/ADNI/RECMHIST_12Jan2024.csv') %>%
  janitor::clean_names()
init_health.raw <- read_csv('resources/ADNI/INITHEALTH_12Jan2024.csv') %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

### smoking
med_hist <- med_hist.raw %>%
  select(phase, rid, ptid, viscode2, visdate, mhnum, mhcur, mhstab) %>%
  group_by(rid) %>%
  slice_min(visdate) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    smk = ifelse(mhnum == 16, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rid) %>%
  summarise(ptid = first(ptid), viscode2 = first(viscode2), visdate = first(visdate), phase = first(phase), smk = sum(smk, na.rm = T)) %>%
  mutate(
    smk = ifelse(smk == 2, 1, smk)
  )

init_health <- init_health.raw %>%
  select(phase, rid, ptid, viscode2, visdate, ihsymptom) %>%
  group_by(rid) %>%
  slice_min(visdate) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    smk = ifelse(ihsymptom == 14, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rid) %>%
  summarise(ptid = first(ptid), viscode2 = first(viscode2), visdate = first(visdate), phase = first(phase), smk = sum(smk, na.rm = T)) %>%
  mutate(
    smk = ifelse(smk >= 2, 1, smk)
  )

smk <- bind_rows(
  med_hist, init_health
) %>%
  group_by(rid) %>%
  slice_min(visdate) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(viscode2 %in% c('f', 'sc')) %>%
  rename(RID = rid)

```

## Merge 
```{r}

tl.merge <- ts %>% select(RID, EXAM_DATE, TL_BP_ADJ)

dnam.merge <- dnam %>% select(
  RID, Edate_methy, 
  PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, DNAmGrimAgev2, AgeAccelGrimv2, CausAge,  DamAge, AdaptAge, DunedinPACE, 
  neutrophil, nk_cell, b_cell, cd4_t_cell, cd8_t_cell, monocyte, 
  # Bas, Bmem, Bnv, CD4mem, CD4nv, CD8mem, CD8nv, Eos, Mono, NK, Neu, Treg
  )

apoe.merge <- apoe %>% select(RID, apoe_geno, apoe, apoe_e2, apoe_e4)

cog.merge <- cog.raw %>% 
  # filter(RID %in% tl.merge$RID) %>%
  select(RID, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE, PHC_Visit, PHC_Sex, PHC_Education, PHC_Ethnicity, PHC_Race, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Diagnosis, 
         PHC_MEM, PHC_EXF, PHC_LAN, PHC_VSP)

fbm.merge <- fluid_bm.raw %>% 
  arrange(RID, PHC_Visit) %>%
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, DRAWDATE, Platform, PHC_AB42, PHC_Tau, PHC_pTau, AT_class)
 
mri.merge <- mri %>% 
  arrange(RID, PHC_Visit) %>%
  distinct(RID, PHC_Visit, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, PHC_ScannerBatchName.1, PHC_ScannerManufacturer, PHC_FieldSgth, EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol_combat, cort_thk, cort_thk_volwt,  gm_vol)

```


### Genetics 
```{r}

genetics <- cog.merge %>% 
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, EXAMDATE, PHC_Age_Cognition) %>%
  left_join(tl.merge, by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE' = "EXAM_DATE")) %>% 
  left_join(dnam.merge, by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE' = 'Edate_methy'))  %>% 
  left_join(apoe.merge, by = c("RID")) %>% 
  left_join(mtdnacn, by = c("RID")) 

## Estimate epigenetic age acceleration
epi_age_acc <- genetics %>%
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, EXAMDATE, PHC_Age_Cognition, 
        TL_BP_ADJ, mtcn,
        CausAge, DamAge, AdaptAge, PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, DNAmGrimAgev2, DunedinPACE, AgeAccelGrimv2,
        neutrophil, nk_cell, b_cell, cd4_t_cell, cd8_t_cell, monocyte
        # Bas, Bmem, Bnv, CD4mem, CD4nv, CD8mem, CD8nv, Eos, Mono, NK, Neu, Treg
        ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CausAge)) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    causeage_aaa_bl = CausAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    damage_aaa_bl = DamAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    adptage_aaa_bl = AdaptAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    phenoage_aaa_bl = PhenoAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    horvath_aaa_bl = Horvathv2 - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    hannum_aaa_bl = Hannum - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    lin_aaa_bl = Lin - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    grimage_aaa_bl = DNAmGrimAgev2 - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
  ) 

raa_causage_mod <- lm(CausAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_phenoage_mod <- lm(PhenoAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_horvath_mod <- lm(Horvathv2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_hannum_mod <- lm(Hannum ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_lin_mod <- lm(Lin ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_grimage_mod <- lm(DNAmGrimAgev2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)

iraa_causage_mod <- lm(CausAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_phenoage_mod <- lm(PhenoAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_horvath_mod <- lm(Horvathv2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_hannum_mod <- lm(Hannum ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_lin_mod <- lm(Lin ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_grimage_mod <- lm(DNAmGrimAgev2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)

# iraa_causage_mod <- lm(CausAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_phenoage_mod <- lm(PhenoAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_horvath_mod <- lm(Horvathv2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_hannum_mod <- lm(Hannum ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_lin_mod <- lm(Lin ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_grimage_mod <- lm(DNAmGrimAgev2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)

raa_mod <- list(
  CausAge = raa_causage_mod, 
  PhenoAge = raa_phenoage_mod, 
  Horvathv2 = raa_horvath_mod, 
  Hannum = raa_hannum_mod, 
  Lin = raa_lin_mod, 
  DNAmGrimAgev2 = raa_grimage_mod
  ) %>%
  map_df(tidy, .id = "test") %>%
    mutate(
    term = case_when(
      term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
      term == "PHC_Age_Cognition" ~ "Slope",
      TRUE ~ term  # Keep other terms unchanged
    ))


epi_age_acc$causage_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_causage_mod)
epi_age_acc$phenoage_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_phenoage_mod)
epi_age_acc$horvath_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_horvath_mod)
epi_age_acc$hannum_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_hannum_mod)
epi_age_acc$lin_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_lin_mod)
epi_age_acc$grimage_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_grimage_mod)

epi_age_acc$causage_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_causage_mod)
epi_age_acc$phenoage_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_phenoage_mod)
epi_age_acc$horvath_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_horvath_mod)
epi_age_acc$hannum_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_hannum_mod)
epi_age_acc$lin_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_lin_mod)
epi_age_acc$grimage_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_grimage_mod)

genetics_bl <- epi_age_acc %>%
  rename(
    tl_bl = TL_BP_ADJ, 
    mtcn_bl = mtcn,
    causage_bl = CausAge, 
    adptage_bl = AdaptAge, 
    damage_bl = DamAge, 
    phenoage_bl = PhenoAge, 
    horvath_bl = Horvathv2, 
    hannum_bl = Hannum, 
    lin_bl = Lin, 
    grimage_bl = DNAmGrimAgev2, 
    ageaccelgrim_bl = AgeAccelGrimv2, 
    dunedinpace_bl = DunedinPACE, 
    neutrophil_bl = neutrophil, 
    nk_cell_bl = nk_cell, 
    b_cell_bl = b_cell, 
    cd4_t_cell_bl = cd4_t_cell, 
    cd8_t_cell_bl = cd8_t_cell, 
    monocyte_bl = monocyte
    ) %>%
  mutate( # Standardize BioAge measures
   z_tl_bl = scale(tl_bl)[,1], 
   z_mtcn_bl = scale(mtcn_bl)[,1],
   z_dnam_bl = scale(causage_bl)[,1], 
   # cat_tl_bl = ntile(z_tl_bl, 3),
   # cat_mtcn_bl = ntile(z_mtcn_bl, 3),
   # cat_dnam_bl = ntile(z_dnam_bl, 3),
   cat_tl_bl = ifelse(z_tl_bl < -1, 1, 0),
   cat_mtcn_bl = ifelse(z_mtcn_bl < -1, 1, 0),
   cat_dnam_bl = ifelse(z_dnam_bl > 1, 1, 0),
   bioage_bl = rowSums(across(c(cat_tl_bl, cat_mtcn_bl, cat_dnam_bl)), na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
    select(RID, EXAMDATE, contains('bl'))


genetics.merge <- genetics %>%
  left_join(genetics_bl, by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE')) %>% 
  # select(RID, PHC_Visit, TL_BP_ADJ) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  fill(tl_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(mtcn_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(adptage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(damage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(ageaccelgrim_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(dunedinpace_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(neutrophil_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(nk_cell_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(b_cell_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(cd4_t_cell_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(cd8_t_cell_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(monocyte_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causeage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(adptage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(damage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(z_tl_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(z_mtcn_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(z_dnam_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(bioage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(apoe, .direction = "updown") %>%
  fill(apoe, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup()

```


### Cogntive Decline 
```{r}

## Might need to filter this to omics bl

adni <- cog.merge %>%
  left_join(select(merge.raw, RID, EXAMDATE, ORIGPROT, CDRSB), by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE')) %>%
  left_join(select(smk, RID, smk), by = c("RID")) %>%
  left_join(fbm.merge, by = c('RID', 'PHC_Visit')) %>%
  left_join(mri.merge, by = c('RID', 'PHC_Visit')) %>%
  # left_join(dx_bl, by = c("RID")) %>%
  left_join(select(genetics.merge, -PHC_Age_Cognition, -PHC_Visit), by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE')) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = ifelse(PHC_Sex == 1, "Male", "Female"), 
    gbl_cog = rowMeans(across(c(PHC_MEM, PHC_EXF, PHC_LAN, PHC_VSP)), na.rm = TRUE),
    race = case_when(
      PHC_Race == 5 & PHC_Ethnicity == 2 ~ "NHW", 
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    educ_cat = case_when(
      PHC_Education <= 12                ~ "HighSchool",
      between(PHC_Education, 13, 16)     ~ "College",
      PHC_Education >= 17                ~ "Graduate"
    ), 
    educ_cat = fct_relevel(educ_cat, 'HighSchool')
    ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(apoe)) %>%
  # filter(!is.na(CausAge)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(causage_bl)) %>%
  ## Exclude participants with only 1 visit
  # filter(n() > 1) %>%
  # Baseline Diagnosis
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate( # Months from baseline genetics visit
    baseline_date = min(EXAMDATE, na.rm = TRUE),  # Get earliest EXAMDATE per RID (baseline)
    months_since_bl = as.numeric(difftime(EXAMDATE, baseline_date, units = "days")) / 30.4375,  # Convert days to months
    age_bl = min(PHC_Age_Cognition, na.rm = TRUE), 
    visit_bl = first(PHC_Visit), 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cdrsb_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit) ~ CDRSB
      ), 
    dx_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit) ~ PHC_Diagnosis
      ), 
    dx_bl = case_when(
     dx_bl == 1 ~ "CN",
     dx_bl == 2 ~ "MCI",
     dx_bl == 3 ~ "AD",
   ),
    dx_bl = fct_relevel(dx_bl, "CN", "MCI", "AD"), 
    ORIGPROT = fct_relevel(ORIGPROT, "ADNI1", "ADNI2", "ADNIGO")
  ) %>% 
  fill(dx_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(cdrsb_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  # filter(dx_bl != "AD") %>%
  # filter(dx_bl != "CN") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    educ = PHC_Education, 
    months = months_since_bl, 
    cohort = ORIGPROT
  ) %>%
  relocate(age_bl, .after = PHC_Age_Cognition) %>%
  relocate(months, .after = PHC_Visit) %>%
  relocate(cohort, .after = RID) %>% 
  relocate(cdrsb_bl, .after = CDRSB) %>%
  relocate(dx_bl, .after = PHC_Diagnosis)  %>%
  relocate(visit_bl, .after = PHC_Visit) 

## Scale time variables

mean_age <- adni %>% group_by(RID) %>% slice_min(PHC_Visit) %>% ungroup() %>% summarise(age = mean(PHC_Age_Cognition, na.rm = T)) %>% pull(age)
sd_age <- adni %>% group_by(RID) %>% slice_min(PHC_Visit) %>% ungroup() %>% summarise(age = sd(PHC_Age_Cognition, na.rm = T)) %>% pull(age)

mean_months <- mean(adni$months, na.rm = TRUE)

adni <- adni %>% 
  mutate(
    months_c = months - mean_months, 
    yrs_c = (months - mean_months) / 12,
    z_age_bl = (age_bl - mean_age) / sd_age,
    age_c = PHC_Age_Cognition - mean_age, 
  ) %>% 
    relocate(months_c, .after = months) %>% 
    relocate(yrs_c, .after = months_c) %>% 
    relocate(z_age_bl, .after = age_bl) %>% 
    relocate(age_c, .after = z_age_bl)

```

## CSF RAW outlier QC
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

csf <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Biospecimen_Analyses/ADSP_PHC_CSF_Dec2023.csv")

iqr_flag <- function(x, k = 1.5) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  (x < (q1 - k * iqr)) | (x > (q3 + k * iqr))
}

csf_out <- csf %>%
  mutate(
    out_ab42 = iqr_flag(AB42_RAW),
    out_tau  = iqr_flag(Tau_RAW),
    out_ptau = iqr_flag(pTau_RAW),
    out_any  = out_ab42 | out_tau | out_ptau
  )

# sanity check that the column exists
names(csf_out)

csf_out %>%
  filter(out_any) %>%
  select(RID, SUBJID, PHASE, VISCODE, PHC_Visit, DRAWDATE, Platform,
         AB42_RAW, Tau_RAW, pTau_RAW,
         PHC_AB42, PHC_Tau, PHC_pTau,
         out_ab42, out_tau, out_ptau) %>%
  arrange(desc(Tau_RAW))  # or arrange(desc(pTau_RAW)), etc.
  #head(25)
sum(csf_out$out_ab42, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(csf_out$out_tau,  na.rm = TRUE)
sum(csf_out$out_ptau, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(csf_out$out_any,  na.rm = TRUE)


csf_out %>%
  filter(out_any) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_RID = n_distinct(RID),
    n_rows = n()
  )
csf_out %>%
  filter(out_any) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abs_phc_tau  = mean(abs(PHC_Tau), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_phc_tau   = max(abs(PHC_Tau), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_phc_ptau = mean(abs(PHC_pTau), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_phc_ptau  = max(abs(PHC_pTau), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
    n_missing_PHC_pTau = sum(is.na(PHC_pTau)),
    n_missing_any_PHC  = sum(is.na(PHC_AB42) | is.na(PHC_Tau) | is.na(PHC_pTau))
  )

phc_missing_check
```

####test
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

csf <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Biospecimen_Analyses/ADSP_PHC_CSF_Dec2023.csv")

# 1) Create log10 variables (like adRutils::transform_log10)
# Use log10(x) only for x > 0; otherwise set NA
csf2 <- csf %>%
  mutate(
    log10_AB42 = if_else(AB42_RAW > 0, log10(AB42_RAW), NA_real_),
    log10_Tau  = if_else(Tau_RAW  > 0, log10(Tau_RAW),  NA_real_),
    log10_pTau = if_else(pTau_RAW > 0, log10(pTau_RAW), NA_real_)
  )

# 2) IQR flagger (same k=1.5 idea, but applied to log10 vars)
iqr_flag <- function(x, k = 1.5) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  (x < (q1 - k * iqr)) | (x > (q3 + k * iqr))
}

csf3 <- csf2 %>%
  mutate(
    out_log10_AB42 = iqr_flag(log10_AB42),
    out_log10_Tau  = iqr_flag(log10_Tau),
    out_log10_pTau = iqr_flag(log10_pTau)
  ) %>%
  # 3) Replace outliers with NA (like replace_outliers_with_na)
  mutate(
    log10_AB42_qc = if_else(out_log10_AB42, NA_real_, log10_AB42),
    log10_Tau_qc  = if_else(out_log10_Tau,  NA_real_, log10_Tau),
    log10_pTau_qc = if_else(out_log10_pTau, NA_real_, log10_pTau)
  )

# Quick counts (how many values were NA'd per biomarker)
csf3 %>%
  summarise(
    n_out_log10_AB42 = sum(out_log10_AB42, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_log10_Tau  = sum(out_log10_Tau,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_log10_pTau = sum(out_log10_pTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_any        = sum(out_log10_AB42 | out_log10_Tau | out_log10_pTau, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
